items.title: Measuring LLMs' Impact on N-Day Exploits: Mythos Preview Builds 8 Firefox + 8 Windows Kernel Exploits Autonomously
items.title_zh: 大语言模型对N-Day漏洞利用的影响：Mythos Preview自主构建8个Firefox和8个Windows内核漏洞利用
items.summary: Anthropic's Frontier Red Team evaluated LLMs on N-day exploit development. Across 18 Firefox patches, Mythos Preview built 8 working exploits autonomously—first in under one hour. On 21 Windows kernel patches (binary-only), it produced 8 full SYSTEM-level privilege escalation chains at ~$2,000/exploit. It triggered crashes for 13 of 14 bugs Microsoft rated 'Exploitation Less Likely/Unlikely.' The patching playbook of monthly cycles and multi-week rollouts no longer holds; exploit bottleneck collapsed to hours.

items.title: SkillOpt: Agent Skills as Trainable Parameters — +23.5 Improvement, Open-Source from Microsoft Research
items.title_zh: SkillOpt：Agent技能参数化训练 — 微软研究院开源，提升23.5分
items.summary: Microsoft Research proposes SkillOpt, treating agent skill files as trainable parameters with a full optimization loop: batch execution, trajectory reflection, bounded text edits, validation gating, rejected-edit feedback, and slow/meta updates. Best or tied-best in all 52 evaluation cells across 6 benchmarks, 7 models (GPT-5.5 to Qwen3.5-4B), 3 execution modes. GPT-5.5 average: 58.8→82.3. Qwen3.5-4B surpassed GPT-5.2 baseline. Skills transfer across harnesses. Compact ~920-token skill files. Open-source.

items.title: Project Fetch Phase Two: Claude Opus 4.7 Robodog 20x Faster Than Humans
items.title_zh: Project Fetch第二阶段：Claude Opus 4.7机器狗比人类快20倍
items.summary: Claude Opus 4.7 operated a robotic quadruped autonomously, ~20x faster than Phase One humans (~37x faster than the Claude-less team). Completed sensor connection, manual control programming, path monitoring, and ball detection. Still struggled with precise manipulation. Signals early era of physical agentic AI.

items.title: Paving the Way for AI Agents in Biology: gget virus Boosts NCBI Retrieval Accuracy to 99.7%
items.title_zh: 为生物学AI Agent铺路：gget virus将NCBI检索准确率提升至99.7%
items.summary: Anthropic benchmarked agents on NCBI Virus retrieval via VirBench (120 queries, 40 pathogens). Frontier models scored 16-91% with high run-to-run variability—one Sonnet 4 run shifted Ebola TMRCA from 2014 to 1922. Adding gget virus deterministic retrieval layer raised all agents above 90% (GPT-5.5 at 99.7%) and eliminated variability.

items.title: Mapping AI-Enabled Cyber Threats: Google DeepMind's LLM ATT&CK Navigator
items.title_zh: AI赋能网络威胁图谱：Google DeepMind发布LLM ATT&CK Navigator
items.summary: Google DeepMind announced the LLM ATT&CK Navigator framework for mapping AI-enabled cyber threats, providing a structured way to assess how LLM agents could be exploited for offensive cyber operations and how to defend against them. Accompanied by a policy analysis of a year's worth of AI cyber threat intelligence.
